segments.motivation: To track project progress, manage team tasks, and visualize workflows.
To oversee team activities, allocate resources, and ensure task completion.
To organize personal tasks, manage their workload, and collaborate on team projects.

tasks.purpose: to get an instant overview of status
by adding comments, attachments, and updates

benefits.claim: Provides a clear visual overview of tasks and project status at a glance.
The intuitive drag-and-drop interface makes it very easy to learn and manage tasks.
Facilitates smooth team collaboration with shared boards and real-time updates.

frictions.claim: May become less effective for very large or complex projects with extensive dependencies and detailed reporting needs.
Lacks some advanced features like Gantt charts or robust time tracking that are present in more comprehensive project management tools.
Reporting and analytics capabilities might be limited for in-depth project analysis.
